description: Deposit a bit field of variable position and length into a u32 (QEMU deposit32)
notes: QEMU deposit32(value, start, length, fieldval), rewritten by us; its assert(start >= 0 && length > 0 && length <= 32 - start) becomes __builtin_assume. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: 13 IR instructions (assume compares included). Whether clang's form is optimal is unknown.
